shots.purpose: Hook. Child POV in bed, clutching duvet, gothic window, moon, swaying branches
Gran's hand tips a tin cup; rice streams onto the INSIDE sill (clue)
Gran leans in, silhouette by candle, finger to lips, whispers
Macro rice grains glint one by one: counted
Dawn breaks in the window; rice glows; safety
26 years later. Torch beam finds boxes, Gran's ribboned portrait, the window
The mirror under black mourning cloth (clue)
Adult hand sweeps the old rice off the sill onto the floor
Black. Eyelids open on a clock at 3:00
Lying awake. Tracery moonlight on ceiling, whispered counting; head turns
Empty window -> slow tilt down -> his own grey hands sorting rice into piles of ten; freeze
Hands freeze and curl; push in on claws: the voice was mine
Grey hand pulls cloth from mirror; reflection shows room and rice, no him
Old claw scratches on INSIDE of the window frame; Gran's memory double-exposed
Last grain pushed onto the last pile
Tilt up to the window: still dark
Casements swing open, curtains billow, grey hand reaches for the night
Cut to black. Whisper 'One.' Title card
